name: singlet_qc_dissociation_stress_detection
title: Dissociation stress score and removal
description: Scores each cell on a fixed panel of ex vivo dissociation stress genes using module_score (default), ucell or aucell, and can exclude the panel or regress the score out before clustering. Requires log-normalised X and a panel fixed before inspecting test labels. Writes obs/dissociation_score; flags are off by default because no threshold is validated. Do not use it to call low-quality cells.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

panel.description: Gene symbols of the stress program, fixed before inspecting test labels; matched to var names.

method.description: Scorer: module_score (expression-matched controls, default), ucell (rank-based) or aucell (recovery curve).

flag.description: Flagging rule applied to the score; off by default.

rule.description: none keeps scores only; within_batch_quantile flags cells above a quantile within each batch.

batch_key.description: obs column of batches for within_batch_quantile; null treats the dataset as one batch.

quantile.description: Score quantile above which cells are flagged within each batch.

pre_clustering.description: Treatment of the stress program before clustering.

mode.description: none keeps the matrix; exclude_panel drops panel genes from clustering features; regress_out removes the score from other genes.

protect_genes.description: In vivo activation genes never excluded or regressed in any mode.

convention.description: Control-gene convention: seurat draws controls per panel gene, scanpy per expression bin.

n_bins.description: Expression bins; null uses the convention's standard value.

n_control.description: Controls per panel gene (seurat) or per bin (scanpy); null uses the convention's standard value.

max_rank.description: Rank cutoff for the capped rank statistic.

max_rank_frac.description: Fraction of all genes used to truncate the recovery curve.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for module_score control sampling; the other methods are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/dissociation_score. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_cells, panel_genes_found, panel_genes_missing, n_flagged, mode. Never raw scores.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
